messages:
Jamal: Quick sync — I'm assembling an ownership + dep map for the 'slatewire' kernel changes (continuous-batching + KV warmup). Posting current plan and who I think owns what. Please correct.
Anya: SGTM. Can you paste the PRs? helps to match tasks.
Jamal: PRs: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/1245 (kernel scheduling), https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/1257 (kv-warmup), https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/1263 (batching heuristics).
Kevin: I'll own kernel scheduling (1245). ETA end of week for first pass. Need infra flag to toggle the new allocator.
Tess: I can take kv-warmup (1257) handoff. Plan to add a lightweight replay-mode and a metrics tag for warm/ cold hits.
Marta: I'll validate batching heuristics (1263) in the perf harness — need a test vector from prod-like traces. @Anya can you export a 5k trace slice?
Anya: on it. exporting now, will drop into the perf-bucket in ~30m.
Jamal: Ownership summary so far: kernel -> @Kevin, kv warmup -> @Tess, batching heuristics -> @Marta (perf validation), infra toggles -> eng-infra (need owner). If anyone else needs to be listed, shout.
Kevin: eng-infra ping: we need a runtime flag behind a rollout gate. @deploy-bot any guidance for short-lived flags vs. config-service rollout?
deploy-bot: Suggestion: use /feature-flag create slatewire_alloc --env=canary --expiry=2w. CI will auto-instrument. See https://go/release-flags
Marta: I'll take the perf vectors once @Anya uploads. Also, I'll run the new batcher with sequence-length distributions A/B.
Tess: FYI: kv warmup relies on a small index snapshot format change — might break older rollbacks. proposing a compatibility mode for 2 sprints.
Jamal: Good catch. Decision needed: compatibility mode (longer dev time) vs hard migration (faster). Preference? @Kevin @Marta
Kevin: lean hard migration if we can fallback to previous model via routing. Otherwise compat mode. We need canary routing in place.
Marta: Can we do both? Hard migration but gate on rollout %, +compat shim in case we need to toggle quickly.
Anya: Uploaded traces: gs://redwood-perf/slatewire/traces/2026-03-15/5k.json
Jamal: Next milestones: 1) Kevin posts kernel PR review by Thu EOD (1736875523). 2) Tess posts kv warmup integration branch by Fri (1736961923). 3) Marta runs perf validation and posts results next Tue (1737134723). If any blocker, update this thread.
Tess: quick note — I'm blocked on a small proto change for index metadata. Filed issue runtime#789. cc @Kevin
Kevin: saw it. I'll review runtime#789 today.
Marta: perf infra note — need temporary quota bump for perf runners. @ci-bot can you request a +2 runner quota for slatewire tests?
ci-bot: Created request CI-442. Eng-infra to approve.
Jamal: Final asks: 1) owners confirm above, 2) drop short status update in this thread when you finish your next action (PR/branch/upload). 3) if you want a canary route, add it to the PR description as: canary: "slatewire-v1 -> 10% us-west".
Kevin: Confirmed, I'll ping when 1245 is up for review. :thumbsup:
Tess: Confirmed. will link 1257 when ready.
Marta: Confirmed. will post perf run link.
Anya: 👍 trace uploaded and shared in #eng-runtime. Let me know if other slices needed.
Jamal: Thanks all. I'll update the ownership doc and ping eng-infra for the flag approval. :raised_hands:
